per_item: aatrox-vexxsoul: FAITHFUL. Poster layout, left-anchored bust, right-half AATROX title + sigil + quote all present. Centered VEXXSOUL.DEVIANTART.COM watermark and top-right DA-style logo confirmed. Quote punctuation typo (END,.) real. Chest genuinely ambiguous flesh-vs-armor; sword only a dark haft at left edge, no hands - all verified. Style band 'other' is fair (AI graphic-poster, fits no listed band). Acceptability 3 is defensible only because the watermark is huge and mid-frame; arguably generous but flagged honestly.

dark-fire-sword (Blood Moon Aatrox): FAITHFUL with one soft call. Murk, shadow crush of lower body, near-unreadable grip hand, crisp ornate blade, top haze key + red ember underglow all verified. Two quibbles: style band 'photobash-cinematic' is arguable - this is a painted official-style splash, painterly-semireal would fit as well; and the pose reads as a slow forward stalk more than strictly 'brooding low-energy'. Neither is a hallucination. Scores 3/3 defensible.

gothic-samira: FAITHFUL. Back 3/4 over-shoulder, corset lacing + braid eye-lead, drifting black petals, low-angle cathedral, candle-vs-window warm/cool split, exceptional skin/tattoo work all confirmed. Flaws real: raised-hand finger articulation slightly odd, the blade(s) behind her back are genuinely spatially confusing (one large horizontal blade + a double-bladed polearm), pale face-crack marking present and could scan as damage, wall paintings soft. 5/5 defensible - strongest technical piece in the set.

lissandra (Coven, official): FAITHFUL. Reclining pose across dark roots, right-of-center subject, gold-eyed crow flock at left (plus one at right edge the note omits - minor), moonlit dress with subsurface glow, eyeless helm, long waxy elongated fingers, crushed near-black shadows all verified. Crows are indeed soft. Note omits the scrying mirror lower-right - harmless omission. 4/5 scores defensible.

samira-phantom-azure-empress: FAITHFUL and usefully honest about AI-gen tells. Verified: gun mechanism semi-melted/ambiguous, odd thumb-finger stacking on grip, incoherent shoulder tattoo, unreadable dark bladed mass lower-right, repetitive scroll-shaped blue flames. Face is clean, value control strong. 'head center-right' is really dead-center to slightly right - trivial. 4/4 scores defensible; this is the clearest AI-origin piece and the note treats it as such.

star-guardian-samira: FAITHFUL. Muzzle-flash key light left, halo ring behind head, star eyepatch + smirk, blade low right, bottom cape swirls, mushy city bg, soft corrupted bird monsters right, small low-detail Soraka cameo (green hair, right side) all verified. Firing-hand fingers slightly stiff with near-merging red nails - real. Note omits a small winged fairy figure center-frame - minor. 5/5 defensible; face/attitude claim holds.

diana (Battle Queen): FAITHFUL. Canted low-angle lunge center-left, magenta petals, right-half pure bokeh murk, blade self-glow keying the face, crisp armor filigree, crescent glaive with moon-magic rings all verified. Rear extended glove hand is simplified/stiff - real. Hair-vs-blade ambiguity confirmed: the white braid falls across the glaive blades and boundaries blur. Petal bokeh does border on smear at left. 5/5 defensible.
systemic_concerns: No hallucinated flaws or strengths found - every claimed flaw was locatable in-image and no claimed absence was contradicted. Reviewer quality is high. Minor systemic notes: (1) score compression at the top - four of seven items sit at acceptability 5, so the premise band for lw-gen should treat 5 as 'operator-tolerated flaws still present', not flawless; (2) style-band edges are soft - item 2 photobash-cinematic vs painterly-semireal is a judgment call, and 'other' on item 1 hides that two of seven approved items are themselves AI-generated with visible tells (items 1 and 5) - this is actually the most important acceptability signal for lw-gen: melted gun mechanisms, incoherent tattoos, and repetitive flame shapes were tolerated when mood/face/value-control were strong; (3) small omissions only (mirror in Lissandra, fairy in SG Samira, right-side crow) - none affect the acceptability premise; (4) the tolerated watermark in item 1 is mid-frame and huge, which is a cleaning-stage problem, not a generator-premise datum - consider excluding watermark tolerance from the lw-gen acceptability floor since ADR-005 removes signatures anyway.
